subject.title: [Bug]: /hooks/agent silently drops accountId — hook dispatch bypasses cron normalization pipeline

question: Should maintainers wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43951 to be refreshed and proven, or replace it with a credited current-main fix for this hook `accountId` bug?
rationale: The bug remains valid and source-reproducible, but the linked implementation PR is open, conflicting, and proof-stalled, so automation should not create a duplicate issue-lane fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Replace on current main
options.body: Open or sponsor a narrow credited replacement that preserves hook `accountId`, updates docs/tests, and provides maintainer-owned redacted proof.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Leave the linked PR as the candidate fix and require the author to rebase, resolve current-main review findings, and add real behavior proof.

options.title: Hold for broader hook delivery design
options.body: Pause the narrow repair only if maintainers want to redesign hook delivery/account routing as a larger API decision.

recommendation.title: Replace on current main
recommendation.body: Open or sponsor a narrow credited replacement that preserves hook `accountId`, updates docs/tests, and provides maintainer-owned redacted proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is closest to the current gateway hook and cron delivery surfaces and was already requested for review on the linked candidate PR.
